name: Floating Action Button
description: Material 3 FAB in FAB, medium, and large sizes with primary, secondary, and surface tones, extended labels, and the expressive FAB menu, plus utilitek's 32px compact chrome that grows into a pill on hover, a corner-pinned FabStack, and scroll collapse/hide.

name: Action Wheel
description: Radial action menu modeled on the Logi Options+ Actions Ring: a small gray close button in the center, a ring of solid circular actions, and a label card pushed outward from each one. Opens at the cursor on right-click via ActionWheelContextMenu. Actions with nested items open a submenu on an outer arc, and variant="arc" drops the ring for a launcher that fans actions toward a direction. Labels always, on hover, or off (tooltips), full ring or arc via startAngle and sweep, solid, violet, primary, secondary, and surface tones, three sizes, and arrow-key navigation.

name: Toolbar
description: Toolbar row with groups, separators, icon buttons, pressed toggles, and a compact select, plus a Material 3 docked variant (standard or vibrant) for the bottom edge of a screen.

name: Number Input
description: Text box for numbers: digits only, clamps to min/max and rounds on blur, Enter jumps to the next field.

name: Lexical Editor
description: Rich text editor built on Lexical with the Standard Toolbar: block types, history, text formats, alignment, and Markdown shortcuts.

name: Time Picker
description: Material 3 time picker: drag the clock dial or type the time, AM/PM or 24-hour, Cancel/OK in a popover.

name: Dialslide
description: Horizontal slider for any row, with a calendar variant: scroll buttons, drag, keyboard and edge fades.

name: Thin Scrollbar
description: Excalidraw-style thin native scrollbar (4px). Use ThinScrollbar or class scrollbar-thin.

name: Cursor
description: Replaces the native cursor. Variants: dot, ring, dot-ring, crosshair, spotlight, blend, arrow, trail. Scoped to children or global.

name: Pill
description: Split badge with a muted label on the left and a contrasting value on the right, in four corner radii.

name: Chip
description: Pressable tag: filter/selection chips with a check when on, action chips with an icon, and removable filter chips. Looks interactive so it is never mistaken for a Badge.

name: Notification Badge
description: Unread marker pinned to an icon: dot, count, or capped count (999+). Red alert tone by default, with brand and neutral tones for non-urgent counts.

name: Indicator
description: Presence dot for avatars and people lists: online, away, busy, offline. Its own colour set, so busy red never reads as unread.

name: Standard Toolbar Count
description: Toolbar counts: result text, filtered-of-total, pill, corner badge on a button, and a selection chip with clear.

name: Wizard
description: Multi-step form in a dialog, a bottom sheet on phones: progress strip, per-step checks and async Continue.

name: Popover Wizard
description: Small multi-step panel anchored to its trigger: header dots, Back and Next, for tours and quick setup.

name: App Bar
description: Material 3 top app bar: Small, Medium and Large flexible (big title that collapses on scroll), and Search, with leading nav, trailing actions and a fill on scroll.
